headline: Mistral releases Mistral Large 4 open weights, 1T-parameter MoE, 1M context
quote: a 1 trillion-parameter natively multimodal Mixture-of-Experts model with 49 billion active parameters per token
claim: Mistral Large 4 is a 1 trillion-parameter natively multimodal MoE with 49B active parameters per token (52B including embeddings), a 1M context window, under the Mistral Ecosystem Open-Weight License.
why_it_matters: Frontier-class open weights, but 1T parameters means datacenter hardware; useful to read the licence and MoE design, not to run on a laptop.
title: mistralai/Mistral-Large-4-1T-A52B · Hugging Face

headline: Liquid AI LFM3-1.7B targets local agents, about 1 GB at 4-bit
quote: at 4-bit precision, it takes about 1 GB of memory, so it fits on any phone or laptop.
claim: LFM3-1.7B (1.73B parameters, 256K-token context, LFM Open License v1.0) is a text model for local agents; the card says it takes about 1 GB at 4-bit and is not recommended for agentic coding or complex multi-step reasoning.
why_it_matters: A small, tool-calling model that fits even an 8 GB laptop per the card, with single-GPU fine-tuning for your own projects.
title: LiquidAI/LFM3-1.7B · Hugging Face

headline: Baidu releases Unlimited-OCR 2, MIT-licensed 3B document parser
quote: [2026/10/27] 🚀 We release Unlimited OCR 2, achieving unlimited-horizon parsing with SR-SWA.
claim: Baidu released Unlimited OCR 2 on 27 Oct 2026 under the MIT licence; it uses Sparse Reference Sliding Window Attention to keep decoding memory nearly constant on long documents, and the page lists 3B params with a new MarathonDocBench benchmark.
why_it_matters: A permissively licensed OCR model for long PDFs you can build on, though the card tests on an 80 GB A800.
title: baidu/Unlimited-OCR-2 · Hugging Face

headline: IBM Granite Switch 4.1.1 patches adapters without retraining base model
quote: Granite Switch 4.1.1 is a patch release. The version number means what it means in software: fully backwards compatible with 4.1
claim: IBM shipped Granite Switch 4.1.1 with an updated multilingual Granite Speech ASR model (10 languages) and an updated Decision adapter; the base model is untouched.
why_it_matters: Shows an adapter-swapping design where you update skills on one endpoint without redownloading a 30B base.
title: Granite Switch 4.1.1 — Update models like you update software
